text:
yvonne: kicking off nara-v2 int8 bringup on staging with the multilingual eval matrix. quick heads-up: initial metrics look fine overall but some locale-specific oddities.
samir: details?
yvonne: ja-vertical chrF dropped ~4.1 vs nara-v2-fp16, and a handful of Arabic samples show mirrored brackets/parentheses in outputs.
akira: did you run a tokenizer-only export to check detok parity?
yvonne: yes. fp16 export detoks match baseline. int8 export shows extra spaces around ruby markers and swapped bracket orientation in RTL contexts.
jamie: can you paste an example?
yvonne: pasted a repro in artifacts: https://ci.redwood/example/nara-v2/1745556666/artifacts (files: ja_ruby_repro.txt, ar_mirror_repro.txt)
eval-bot: snapshot: nara-v2-int8 | chrF-ja-vertical 21.3 (-4.1) | BLEU-ja-ltr 29.7 (-0.2) | zh 33.0 (+0.6) | ar-rtl 19.8 (-2.0) | token-delta 1.2% | detok-failures 37
akira: interesting token-delta is concentrated on small set of codepoints: ZWJ, KATAKANA MIDDLE DOT, RUBY OPEN/END.
samir: any changes in the packing script recently? packing bug would shift ids and create detok drift.
jamie: packaging team did a small refactor to reduce memcpy in the vocab packer last week.
yvonne: repro snippet (from ja_ruby_repro.txt):
```
入力: 漢字(ふりがな)テキスト。
Expected: 漢字ふりがなテキスト。
int8-output: 漢字 ( ふりがな ) テキスト 。
```
akira: spacing inside parens again. also note punctuation fullwidth space inserted before period. that's a detok postprocess mismatch.
samir: for Arabic: sample shows '(' and ')' reversed visually: expected '(سلام)' got ')سلام('. suspect bidi mirroring applied incorrectly or mirrored glyphs coming from tokenization order change.
jamie: i pulled token id diffs between exports:
# id-diff summary
mismatches: [4890: U+200D, 7711: U+30FB, 9234: U+E0100]
# most map to combining marks, zwj, and ruby/compat chars

akira: looks like packer alignment logic when vocab_size % 256 > 200 used a filler offset. overflow edge-case perhaps.
yvonne: i also ran int8 with --preserve-indices flag and the detok issues disappeared in a small smoke run. chrF recovered to within 0.3 of fp16 for sampled ja-vertical.
samir: that strongly implicates the packer reindexing optimization. can you open a diff PR to revert the memcpy optimization?
jamie: i'll draft a PR with the revert + a unit test that encodes sequences containing ZWJ + ruby + fullwidth punctuation. add a bidi RTL bracket test too.
yvonne: plan: 1) revert packer change and re-export int8 2) run targeted holdout for ja-vertical & ar-rtl 3) add unit tests 4) if green, promote to canary.
eval-bot: created ticket ML-6012 (nara-v2 int8 detok/bidi regression) with artifact links and failing examples.
akira: one more ask: capture raw token stream for the failing sample (token ids and unicode codepoints) so we can confirm mapping.
yvonne: will collect and upload token streams after re-export. small win: int8 latency improved ~10% on p4 nodes, so if we can fix quality it's a net benefit.
samir: thanks everyone. jamie tag me on the PR and i'll help with release notes. keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
